name: Aura Points
description: Roll one of 12 auras with /aura roll and buy its active abilities in /aura shop, triggered with rebindable keys. Level an aura's Mastery, awaken its Ultimate, combine auras in Team Combos, and test yourself in the arena. Aura - a scoreboard currency paid by quests, bosses and Trials - also buys points for the built-in Puffish skill trees, cosmetics and rerolls. Requires Pufferfish's Skills + Attributes, GeckoLib, and on the client Player Animator.
